scope: native multiplayer room browser + room-scoped text chat (follow-up round)

authority_contract.chat_bounds: sanitizeText: control strip (\u0000-\u001f,\u007f) + JS trim (incl NBSP/FEFF/ideographic) + slice(0,200) in UTF-16 units; per-peer 300 ms floor; room-scoped broadcast

followups_addressed.browser_selection_populates_map_mode: room_selected now carries the full record; lobby select_room selects the advertised map/mode when the local registry supports them, else reports unsupported honestly and leaves the manual choice
followups_addressed.endpoint_rebind: request_rooms reconnects explicitly to the entered endpoint when it differs from the bound session endpoint while unseated; browse_rooms allows phase -4; the browser shows the bound endpoint
followups_addressed.model_strictness: normalize_room requires a String roomId; fractional player counts are unknown; chat_line requires String text/name and an integral peerId before claiming self
followups_addressed.utf16_ceiling: Model bounds by UTF-16 units (no surrogate split) and mirrors JS trim; client.send_chat reuses Model.sanitize
followups_addressed.chat_room_scope: bound_room is synced before appending so the first new-room line survives the welcome poll; disconnect clears the draft and closes the modal; docs state room scope is authority-ordered, not frame-verified

observed_this_round.live_journey: written + node --check clean; not run (needs imported content assets)
